request: Owner: «иконки как-то выглядят топорно… найди золотую середину, чтобы всё было в одном дизайн-коде, но с упором на реализм, но не до конца»; the first flat SVG set was rejected: «они стали и слопнули… ты ушёл в слишком минимализм». Small icons for facts (deadline, duration, where to get), word explanations, done marks, locks, documents.
model: gpt_image_2_5 (Higgsfield), variant flare, quality high, 1k, 1:1, transparent background
promptTemplate: Editorial still-life illustration rendered photorealistically, composed as an icon: [object]. Front three-quarter view from slightly above, centred and filling most of the square frame, bold readable silhouette that stays clear at small sizes. Realistic materials and crisp detail with gentle illustrative touches: softly simplified forms, hand-painted highlights and a faint warm ink line along the silhouette, like a premium magazine product illustration. Soft diffused studio light from the upper left, gentle contact shadow directly beneath the object. Warm neutral palette with one accent of tomato red. One isolated object on a transparent background, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no emblems, no flags, no people, no hands.
processing: Downloaded inside the Higgsfield sandbox, trimmed, fitted to 120px inside a 128px square, exported as WebP q80 alpha90 with ImageMagick; byte-identical copies (sha256 below) in public/illustrations/icons. Reviewed at 24, 48 and 216px on #FFFDF9: no text, numerals, emblems, flags or people.
